title: SUPERVISOR MANUFATURA
description:
Sobre nós:

O Iveco Group é um líder global nos setores de transporte e veículos comerciais. Nossa motivação é o desejo de adotar mudanças visando um futuro mais sustentável. Com marcas exclusivas e pessoas únicas, o Iveco Group tem um portfólio comercial diversificado que abrange uma ampla gama de veículos comerciais e especializados, assim como uma oferta completa de powertrain.

Sobre a vaga:

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar o planejamento e execução das atividades de manufatura de equipes multifuncionais;
  • Alinhamento com os procedimentos operacionais definidos, normas de segurança e meio ambiente vigentes;
  • Otimização de fluxos e processos e acompanhando os indicadores;
  • Identificação de desvios e/ou oportunidades de melhoria ou ações mitigadoras;
  • Realização de projetos que visam redução e ou gestão eficiente do custo e demais indicadores da área,.

Requisitos obrigatórios

Formação Superior em Engenharia, Administração e área correlatas.

Imprescindível vivência em Indústria Automotiva, produção em Série, Lean Manufacturing e experiencia em cargo de liderança.

Idioma

Inglês desejável.

Um pouco do que o Iveco Group oferece para você:

  • Previdência Privada;
  • Assistência Médica sem coparticipação;
  • Auxílio Medicamento e vacina;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio odontológico;
  • Auxílio Alimentação;
  • Wellhub;
  • Desconto na compra de carros Stellantis;
  • Entre outros.

Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Nós 'trabalhamos com forças diversas', pois acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas nos fazem crescer como organização, nos desafiam a evoluir continuamente e contribuem para a construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável. Por isso, convidamos pessoas de todos os gêneros, raças, idades, orientações sexuais e capacidades físicas a se candidatarem e fazerem parte do nosso time.

Vem com a gente nessa estrada!

Explore nosso mundo e saiba mais em nosso site: Home | Iveco Brasil | Iveco

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Senior Installation Analysis Engineer
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Installation Analysis discipline. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Installation Analysis team and other related teams and ensures they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Direct Engineering team when assigned as a Project Coordinator on projects
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short-term work activities in own area
  • Communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore, when required to do so
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for Variation Orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close cooperation with other engineering disciplines, Planning, Fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in the preparation of estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and workhour estimates
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare Discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications, as required
  • Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Construction/Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare and review design reports
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • When assigned, assist procurement personnel in producing Discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing and reviewing requisitions, evaluating technical quotations and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Check engineering performed by others within the Discipline
  • Perform design verification through single-discipline check/inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary, and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Participate in internal, Customer, and third-party technical audits on engineering deliverables and vendor documents
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries, etc.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and of the discipline
  • In the Pipeline installation discipline, perform/review Pipeline Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for transportation and installation:
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • In the Structural Installation discipline, perform/review Structural Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • In the Naval Installation discipline, perform /review Naval Architecture Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation
  • Additional skills (preferred, not mandatory) - perform/review designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as:
  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
  • Loadout procedures and guidance during the operations
  • Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as floatover, stackings roll-ups, etc.
  • Weighing procedures
  • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
  • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
  • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures

Reports to: Discipline Lead Engineer

Liaise With: All Engineering disciplines, Fabrication Group, Safety Dept, Document Control, Procurement Group,

Subcontractors, Project Management Team, Vendors, and Customers

Supervises: Engineers

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master's degree preferred)
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable for onshore and offshore construction
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:

HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.

We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .

Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.

If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!

Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Full Time

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate, commensurate with experience

About Design Manager

Design Manager (+DesignSpec) is a leading provider of project management and accounting software tailored specifically for interior design firms. For over 30 years, we’ve helped thousands of designers run more efficient, profitable businesses with our cloud-based platform that integrates purchasing, budgeting, time tracking, and client communication in one seamless solution. As we grow, we're investing heavily in our data infrastructure to enhance product capabilities and improve client outcomes.

About the Role

We’re seeking a skilled Data Engineer to support our product and technology team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, analyzing data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You'll be the first and only dedicated data analytics team member , so we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable operating independently, defining structure, and solving complex data challenges.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes
  • Clean, validate, and structure raw data from various sources to ensure data quality and usability
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decision-making
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics to stakeholders
  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements
  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability
  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed
  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data
  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language
  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact
  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar
  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight

Nice to Have

  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments
  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains

Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly compensation
  • High-impact role with significant autonomy and visibility
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of data and analytics at a growing SaaS company
  • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment
  • Possibility for contract extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business needs

title: Analista de RH (R&S e DP)

Buscamos um(a) Analista de RH Generalista para atuar diretamente em um de nossos clientes, uma empresa de logística reconhecida no mercado. Você será o ponto focal de RH dentro do cliente, sendo responsável por garantir a excelência operacional nas rotinas de Departamento Pessoal (DP) e Recrutamento & Seleção (R&S), contribuindo diretamente para o clima organizacional e a atração de talentos.

Este cargo é ideal para um profissional dinâmico, com perfil "hands-on", que deseja estar no dia a dia das operações de RH e fazer a diferença em um ambiente desafiador.

Principais Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Departamento Pessoal (DP):

  • Processar e controlar a admissão, demissão, férias, afastamentos e licenças dos colaboradores.
  • Elaborar e controlar documentos obrigatórios (e-Social, DIRF, GFIP, CAGED, etc.).
  • Conhecer e aplicar as normas da CLT e convenções coletivas de trabalho.
  • Realizar o fechamento da folha de pagamento, incluindo cálculos de verbas rescisórias, benefícios e impostos.
  • Administrar os benefícios corporativos (Vale-Transporte, Vale-Refeição/Alimentação, Plano de Saúde, etc.).
  • Garantir a conformidade legal de todos os processos trabalhistas.
  • Atuar como interface entre a empresa e os colaboradores para esclarecimentos de dúvidas sobre folha e benefícios.

Recrutamento e Seleção (R&S):

  • Realizar todo o ciclo de R&S, desde a abertura da requisição até a integração do novo colaborador.
  • Divulgar vagas em portais e canais especializados.
  • Triagem de currículos, aplicação de testes e dinâmicas em grupo.
  • Realização de entrevistas por competência e fit cultural.
  • Elaboração e apresentação de propostas comerciais (offer).
  • Acompanhamento de indicadores (KPIs) de R&S, como tempo de fechamento, custo por contratação e turnover.
  • Manter um banco de talentos ativo e organizado.
  • Garantir uma experiência positiva do candidato durante todo o processo.

Atividades Gerais de RH:

  • Apoiar na elaboração de documentos internos (contratos, aditivos, comunicados).
  • Participar de projetos de melhoria contínua nos processos de RH.
  • Auxiliar no controle de prazos e documentação do Programa de Integridade (se aplicável).
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento e manutenção de um clima organizacional saudável.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Formação completa em Administração, Psicologia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência em funções generalistas de RH, com vivência sólida e comprovada em Departamento Pessoal e Recrutamento & Seleção .
  • Conhecimento avançado na legislação trabalhista e previdenciária (CLT).
  • Experiência prática com sistemas de folha de pagamento (Dominio, TOTVS, SAP, Senior, etc.).
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado do Pacote Office (Excel para elaboração de relatórios e planilhas).

Desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior atuando in house (diretamente alocado no cliente).
  • Conhecimento em e-Social.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de R&S (Pandapé, Vagas.com , LinkedIn Recruiter).
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de assessment e mapeamento de perfil comportamental.

Competências Comportamentais (Fit Cultural)

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva: Para lidar com diferentes níveis hierárquicos.
  • Proatividade e autonomia: Para tomar decisões e resolver problemas no dia a dia.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes: Fundamental para as rotinas de DP.
  • Resiliência e capacidade de multitarefa: Para gerir demandas de DP e R&S simultaneamente.
  • Discrição e ética: Para lidar com informações confidenciais.
  • Postura consultiva: Saber orientar gestores e colaboradores.
  • Ter visão " People First " para agir coletivamente

title: Coordenador de projetos
description:
Sobre a Gruen

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

  • Conhecimento técnico em projetos com equipamentos como chillers, dry-coolers, trocadores de calor, bombas de vácuo, compressores, sopradores, vasos de pressão, válvulas e instalações de grande porte (tubulações e elétrica).
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de projetos com valores superiores a R$ 10 milhões.
  • Planejamento de projetos utilizando MS Project.
  • Realizar follow-up crítico e acompanhamento técnico de todas as disciplinas para garantir entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

  • Avaliar as demandas dos prestadores de serviços e das seguradoras, identificando quais OPMEs são frequentemente utilizados e quais são necessários para atender às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Identificar e qualificar fornecedores de OPME, avaliando seu histórico, qualidade dos produtos, preços e condições de entrega;

  • Desenvolver pacotes comerciais que incluam combinações de OPMEs para diferentes tipos de cirurgias ou tratamentos, otimizando custos e facilitando a implementação pelos prestadores;
  • Acompanhar e analisar os custos relacionados a OPMEs utilizados nas coberturas de saúde, garantindo que as despesas estejam de acordo com o orçamento da seguradora;
  • Manter um relacionamento contínuo com os fornecedores, assegurando que a qualidade dos produtos e serviços oferecidos permaneçam em conformidade com os padrões acordados.

Realizar auditorias periódicas sobre o uso de OPME nas instituições de saúde, para garantir que os materiais adquiridos estejam sendo utilizados adequadamente e conforme as políticas da seguradora;

  • Manter um relacionamento contínuo com os fornecedores, assegurando que a qualidade dos produtos e serviços oferecidos permaneçam em conformidade com os padrões acordados;

  • Elaborar relatórios sobre o desempenho dos contratos de OPME, analisando resultados financeiros e operacionais, para oferecer recomendações e ajustes quando necessário;
  • Esta atividade envolve a cotação e a negociação de preços e condições para a realização de procedimentos cirúrgicos, incluindo a compra direta de OPMEs necessários;
  • Solicitar e receber propostas de diferentes fornecedores para os materiais e serviços necessários. É importante comparar não apenas os preços, mas também as condições de entrega e suporte;
  • As propostas recebidas quanto à qualidade dos materiais, prazos de entrega e custos. Isso inclui revisar a conformidade com as exigências técnicas e normativas;

  • Após a realização dos procedimentos, coletar feedback dos prestadores sobre a qualidade dos OPMEs e serviços oferecidos. Usar essas informações para ajustar futuras negociações e contratos;

title: Frontend Developer (Angular)
description:
In SOTEC Consulting - Astek Group, we are seeking an Angular Front-End Developer with strong experience building real-time, data-driven web applications. If you enjoy delivering high-performance, scalable user interfaces in technically challenging environments, we want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain web applications using modern Angular .
  • Collaborate with backend teams and contribute to the development and integration of Java-based APIs and microservices .
  • Ensure smooth communication between front-end and backend services (RESTful APIs, JSON, etc.).

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to real-time rendering and UI responsiveness .
  • Stay updated on the latest trends in both frontend and backend development.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Experience implementing real-time data features (e.g., ag-Grid or similar tools).
  • Hands-on experience as a Java developer , especially with microservices (Spring Boot or similar frameworks).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 .
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with JSON.
  • Familiarity with responsive and adaptive design principles.
  • Experience using version control systems ( Git ).
  • Strong communication skills in English (minimum B2 level) .

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with state management libraries ( NgRx, Akita , etc.).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies ( Docker, Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Charts ).
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience in financial services or other real-time, data-intensive industries.
  • Interest or experience in UX design and tools like Figma or Adobe XD .
  • Strong communication skills in Spanish .

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

Como Analista de Cobrança e Retenção, você será responsável por conduzir o relacionamento com clientes em momentos críticos do ciclo, especialmente em situações de inadimplência, desalinhamento de expectativas ou perda momentânea de percepção de valor.

Seu papel é estratégico: garantir que o cliente mantenha clareza sobre seu plano de crescimento, entenda os próximos passos e execute corretamente a jornada para renovar e recomprar com previsibilidade.

Nesta função, você atuará com abordagem consultiva, combinando princípios de Customer Success, operações de cobrança, recuperação de crédito e gestão de objeções, sempre com foco na manutenção da receita e saúde da carteira.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir contatos ativos e receptivos com clientes em atraso, risco de churn ou perda de percepção de valor.
  • Identificar a causa raiz da inadimplência (financeira, técnica, operacional ou de expectativa) e propor caminhos realistas de regularização.
  • Resgatar a visão estratégica do cliente, conectando o plano contratado aos resultados esperados.
  • Estruturar negociações e acordos financeiros que permitam continuidade saudável do contrato.
  • Controlar objeções com técnica e empatia, garantindo que o cliente se sinta acompanhado e orientado.
  • Executar rotinas de cobrança consultiva, evitando processos mecânicos e focando no impacto do plano no negócio do cliente.
  • Acompanhar SLAs de contatos, follow-ups, acordos e compromissos assumidos.
  • Mapear riscos de cancelamento e agir preventivamente para evitar churn.
  • Alimentar o CRM com histórico, status, acordos e próximos passos, mantendo previsibilidade e organização.
  • Colaborar com times internos (CS, financeiro, comercial e operações) na construção de rotinas que melhorem retenção e adimplência.
  • Gerar percepções qualitativas sobre comportamento dos clientes, objeções recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria no produto/atendimento.

Competências desejadas

  • Comunicação clara e empática: saber conduzir conversas difíceis sem perder a conexão.
  • Sem medo do telefone, nosso clientes quer ser ouvido! Comunicação em voz é mais eficiente!
  • Perfil consultivo: entender o contexto e orientar com visão de negócio.
  • Resiliência emocional: lidar bem com cenários críticos, objeções, frustrações e pressão.
  • Negociação e argumentação: construir acordos viáveis e sustentáveis.
  • Organização e precisão: registrar dados e cumprir processos com excelência.
  • Visão sistêmica: enxergar a jornada completa do cliente e o impacto da retenção na empresa.
  • Disciplina e compromisso: acompanhar pendências, prazos e acordos até a resolução.
  • Colaboração: trabalhar próximo a CS, Financeiro e Comercial para garantir resultado coletivo.

Sobre a DS.Marketing

Empresa especialista em impulsionar vendas no varejo por meio de tecnologia, dados e automação. Democratizamos o acesso ao marketing digital para o empreendor do Brasil profundo!

title: Especialista em Engenharia (Dados)
description:

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

  • Participar de grupos de trabalho, contribuindo com materiais, análises e organização das informações.

  • Domínio avançado em Power BI e Excel.
  • Conhecimento em Python (ou linguagens semelhantes de análise de dados).

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Requisitos :

Experiência em Java (JDK 8+), Spring Boot, Hibernate e multithreading.

SQL e Gerenciamento de Banco de Dados – o Sólido conhecimento de SQL, bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) e técnicas de otimização.

Microsserviços e Desenvolvimento de APIs – o Experiência em design de APIs RESTful e trabalho com arquitetura de microsserviços.

Otimização de Desempenho – o Proficiência em indexação de banco de dados, otimização de consultas, cache (Redis, Memcached) e ajuste de JVM.

Nuvem e DevOps – o Familiaridade com plataformas de nuvem (Azure), pipelines de CI/CD e conteinerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Segurança e Boas Práticas – o Compreensão de autenticação (OAuth, JWT), criptografia e práticas de codificação segura.

Design de Sistemas e Escalabilidade – o Conhecimento de sistemas distribuídos, filas de mensagens e arquiteturas de alta disponibilidade.

Liderança e Colaboração de Equipes – o Experiência em liderar equipes de desenvolvimento, promovendo a colaboração entre Desenvolvimento, Operações e Garantia da Qualidade.

Controle de versão – Experiência sólida com comandos Git (clone, commit, push, pull, branching) e trabalho com repositórios no GitHub/GitLab/BitBucket.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Podcast Producer
description:
Podcast Producer (Full-Service Management) – Sofia Health

Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Role

Sofia Health is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Podcast Producer to manage the full production workflow of our weekly interview podcast, Sofia Unfiltered . This role handles guest communication, scheduling, episode preparation, editorial coordination, and project management from pre-production through publishing.

We interview physicians, psychologists, authors, wellness experts, and thought leaders. You must be able to communicate professionally, manage multiple moving pieces, and maintain a calm, supportive tone consistent with our brand.

⭐ What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Guest Communication & Outreach
  • Manage all communication with guests from initial outreach to post-episode follow-up
  • Schedule interviews, send confirmations/reminders, and provide prep materials
  • Collect bios, headshots, books, links, and required release forms
  • Draft guest outreach emails and pitch new guests aligned with upcoming content themes
  • Maintain guest pipeline, schedules, and assets in Notion/Google Drive
Episode Planning & Production
  • Prepare episode briefs and host prep sheets
  • Attend live recordings (optional but preferred) to track timestamps and notes
  • Review raw audio/video and provide clear, detailed edit notes to the editor
  • Restructure episodes when needed for clarity, flow, and narrative arc
  • Collaborate on episode titles, angles, hooks, and story direction
  • Choose main promotional clips and quotes for social content
Editing Coordination
  • Send the editor cut notes that are clear, accurate, and time-stamped
  • Review first edit, request revisions, and ensure quality before publishing
  • Ensure the final episode reflects brand voice, pacing, clarity, and guest experience
Publishing & Show Management
  • Write compelling show notes, descriptions, summaries, and timestamps
  • Prepare publishing assets (titles, tags, categories, episode artwork if needed)
  • Upload weekly episodes to our hosting platform (Spotify for Podcasters or similar)
  • Track episode performance metrics and maintain publishing calendar
Marketing & Promotion Support
  • Coordinate with the social media team to deliver clips, quotes, and captions
  • Identify promotional opportunities through guests’ audiences
  • Support the creation of audiograms, reels, and short-form content briefs
Monetization & Growth
  • Assist in creating sponsorship decks and packages
  • Research relevant brand partners to pitch
  • Coordinate guest cross-promotion to increase downloads
  • Identify podcast swaps and collaboration opportunities
  • Track growth trends and propose strategies to expand reach
Host & Media Outreach (Podcast Guest Booking)
  • Research aligned podcasts across wellness, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, mental health, women’s health, lifestyle medicine, and business growth
  • Create a list of high-quality podcasts suitable for Riley as a guest
  • Draft personalized podcast pitches in Riley’s voice
  • Send and manage outreach emails to podcast hosts and producers
  • Track outreach, follow-ups, and confirmed appearances in Notion or a CRM
  • Coordinate scheduling, prep materials, and talking points
  • Prepare Riley with a one-sheet, interview brief, and relevant episodes of the host
  • Identify opportunities for backlinks, newsletter swaps, and co-marketing
  • Track results and optimize pitches based on acceptance rates
You’re a Great Fit If You…
  • Have real podcast producing experience (required—not entry-level)
  • Have excellent written English and can write in a warm, professional tone
  • Are organized and reliable with strong project management skills
  • Love structure, systems, checklists, and keeping details tight
  • Can communicate confidently with high-profile guests
  • Can listen to an episode and identify what needs to be cut for clarity and flow
  • Are comfortable giving editors detailed, accurate instructions
  • Enjoy managing timelines, assets, and follow-ups
  • Can work independently and solve problems proactively
  • Are calm under pressure and able to meet weekly deadlines
⭐ Required Skills & Experience
  • 2+ years experience as a Podcast Producer , Podcast Manager , or similar
  • Experience working with audio/video editors
  • Strong writing and communication skills
  • Ability to review episodes and give editorial direction
  • Experience managing guests and scheduling interviews
  • Familiarity with publishing platforms (Spotify for Podcasters, Buzzsprout, etc.)
  • Strong organizational skills with tools like Notion, Trello, Asana, or Airtable
  • Comfortable coordinating social media assets
  • Ability to work in US time zones when needed

Bonus:

  • Experience with sponsorship outreach or monetization
  • Background in wellness, psychology, health, or coaching content
  • Experience producing long-form interview-style shows
  • Ability to identify clips for short-form video

title: Coordenador de Logística

O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos.   • Apoiar o processo orçamentário e as premissas de tendências de mercado.
  • Gerenciar os custos logísticos, incluindo planejados versus reais, por cliente/região e como percentual da receita.
  • Acompanhar a legislação.
  • Implementar as melhores práticas; colaborar com colegas para compartilhar conhecimento e aprendizado, impulsionando a melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com operações/fábricas, fornecedores e consultores para otimizar gastos por meio de projetos técnicos.
  • Estabelecer uma rotina de Rastreamento e Acompanhamento: monitorar entregas, reclamações, ocorrências e custos extras, se houver.
  • CRM (Gestão de Relacionamento com o Cliente) responsável por Incidentes/Reclamações Logísticas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Logística, Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Comércio Internacional ou áreas afins.

title: High Ticket closer
description:
ABOUT US

Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE

We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline
  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion
  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach
  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions
  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1+ years of commission sales experience
  • Strong
  • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability
  • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses
  • Remote-friendly work environment
  • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development
  • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Analista de Inteligência Artificial
description:

• Responsável pera verificação da viabilidade técnica e econômica para implantação da IA;

O que esperamos do nosso Analista de Inteligência Artificial:

title: Cross Product Technical Project Manager
description:

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: and

Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices. Job Description

Ready to level up your career?

Playtech’s Cross Product Solutions unit is looking for a Cross Product Technical Project Manager with a curious mindset, excellent communication, and good technical troubleshooting skills.

Submit your resume in English, press play, and let us design future technology together!

Your influential mission. You will...

  • Be the technical lead and focal point in complex and strategic business projects by managing the end-to-end solution delivery for our clients.
  • Collaborate closely with various product and development teams across Playtech.
  • Lead the project lifecycle, overseeing development, implementation, and testing to ensure it aligns with objectives and delivers high-quality results on time and within scope.
  • Proactively manage project changes, identify risks, and implement strategic contingency plans.
  • Coordinate and collaborate with internal and external resources by conducting regular meetings to ensure alignment and project success.
Qualifications

Components for success. You...

  • Have at least 3 years of working experience in the IT field.
  • Have experience in project management/coordination from start to finish.
  • Possess a foundational knowledge of IT Infrastructure and architecture.
  • Understand software development practices and methodologies.
  • Are proactive, self-motivated, and require minimal supervision.
  • Are curious and want to solve problems.
  • Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Have exceptional communication skills and thrive in interacting with new people.
  • Are a true team player at heart, but also willing to take ownership of your area of responsibility.
  • Appreciate the good sense of humor.
Additional Information

Thrive in a culture that values...

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A commitment to innovation and excellence.
  • A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is welcome.
  • Comprehensive benefits and competitive compensation.

CROSS PRODUCT SOLUTIONS UNIT

The Cross Product Solutions unit at Playtech is a unique team with a crucial role in our company's projects. We have the privilege of working with all of Playtech's products, managing technical delivery, and providing essential support. Our focus is to ensure that every Playtech employee's hard work reaches our customers with the highest level of quality. Join us as we collaborate, strategize, and deliver exceptional solutions that drive success.

PLAYTECH SAO PAOLO

Join the team at our new Brazilian Playtech Managed Services office, where we work together to support and enhance our live products and services. Be part of a global, dynamic, and innovative team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

title: Gerente de EHS
description:
Buscamos: Gerente de EHS (inglês avançado/fluente) para uma multinacional líder no setor de energia e gás, com presença global e forte compromisso com segurança, sustentabilidade e inovação

Resumo da Posição:

O Gerente de EHS é responsável por desenvolver, implementar e manter programas de meio ambiente, saúde e segurança, garantindo conformidade com todas as regulamentações aplicáveis. Este papel promove um ambiente de trabalho seguro e sustentável, impulsionando a melhoria contínua no desempenho de EHS, com foco em processos químicos e operações envolvendo gases.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e aplicar políticas, procedimentos e padrões de EHS.
  • Realizar auditorias, inspeções e avaliações de risco em processos químicos e sistemas de gases.
  • Investigar incidentes e quase acidentes; implementar ações corretivas.
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos regulatórios (normas locais e internacionais).
  • Gerenciar programas de descarte de resíduos e materiais perigosos.
  • Liderar iniciativas de preparação e resposta a emergências.
  • Ministrar treinamentos e programas de conscientização em EHS para colaboradores.
  • Manter registros precisos e preparar relatórios de conformidade.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato com órgãos reguladores e auditores externos.
  • Monitorar indicadores de EHS e recomendar melhorias.

Qualificações:

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciências Ambientais, Segurança do Trabalho, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 5 anos em gestão de EHS ou função similar, com atuação em processos químicos e gases.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Setores desejados: Indústria química, agronegócio, papel e celulose, óleo e gás.
  • Certificações: Desejável CSP, CIH, ISO14001, OHSAS18001.
  • Competências: Conhecimento sólido das normas de EHS, gestão de riscos e treinamentos. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e liderança.

Habilidades Técnicas:

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.

• Experiência comprovada liderando equipes criativas e grandes volumes de produção.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development

Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).

Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.

Location: Brazil

The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.

The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.

Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Electrical Engineering analyst (R&D)
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking an Electrical Engineering analyst to join our R&D team. This role focuses on the design, development, and testing of electrical and electronic systems for new products, ensuring seamless transition from concept to production. The specialist will collaborate with suppliers, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, reliable, and cost-competitive products.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and refine the design of electrical components to support scalable and efficient product manufacturing.
  • Collaborate closely with suppliers to develop and qualify electrical components, ensuring alignment with production requirements.

  • Experience in electrical design, testing, and manufacturing support within an R&D environment.

  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Willingness to travel as necessary.

  • Knowledge of embedded systems and firmware development.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes and supplier management.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency

Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates

Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements

Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

title: AI Gateway Engineer
description:
AI Gateway Engineer

We are seeking a skilled AI Gateway Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AI or API gateways, a strong background in backend development, and expertise in deploying and optimizing AI/ML models in a production environment. You will be instrumental in building and scaling our AI infrastructure within an enterprise-grade setting.

  • Design and manage AI/API gateways like Kong, Mosaic, or Portkey.

  • Leverage AWS to build and manage our cloud infrastructure.
  • Implement and manage observability tools, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), Grafana, and Prometheus , to monitor system health and performance.
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of AI models.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of AI solutions.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Proven experience with API or AI gateways (e.g., Kong, Mosaic, Portkey).
  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Go ; proficiency in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with AI/ML optimization and productization .
  • Expertise in AWS , including its various services for building scalable applications.
  • Familiarity with observability tools like OTel, Grafana, and Prometheus.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering .
  • A history of working in enterprise-grade environments .
Other Details:
  • Location: Remote (preferred in LATAM region)
  • Length: 1+ Year
  • Client: Gaming Giant

We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary.
